title: What survives without a record?
hook: A toy scratch list receives three entries per round; compare two explicit loss rules.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to distinguish external persistence in a storage model from a measured cognitive benefit

misconception: Counting preserved entries establishes a general improvement in human reasoning from external tools.
objective: Distinguish external persistence in a storage model from a measured cognitive benefit.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: Invented entry inflow and deterministic losses; no duplicate entries or record capacity limits; losses occur after arrivals each round. The scratch list retains {A}; the persistent record {B}. Removing the stipulated losses preserves all incoming entries.
